title: A video presenter over a slide made of DOM
blurb: A video with transparency, or the camera with its background keyed out, drawn over HTML slides in one canvas. The slide's link, form and text work under the video, and the canvas is sent as a camera.
question: Can a person from a video with transparency, or from a camera with its background removed, be composed over a slide that is live DOM in one canvas that is also a stream, while the slide's links, form controls and text selection keep working under the person?
result: Yes. The video is drawn as pixels, so every hit goes to the slide. Alpha video, a chroma key and a difference key work. The browser's own segmentation mask wasn't offered by the test camera.
